parts.text:
For this route, the maximum value of v, the speed of the ferry, is 40 km/h.
Jin wants the total time from when the ferry returns to the island to when it next arrives at the
mainland to be no more than 35 minutes.
Work out if it is possible for the ferry to complete the journey in this time.
